# Totem Excavation

Dig out selected areas with seven tiers of mining hammers: wood, stone, copper, iron, gold, diamond, and netherite. Each hammer keeps its own selection, so you can carry separate tools for different work areas.

## Controls

1. Hold a hammer in your main hand and sneak-left-click an eligible block to set Corner A.
2. Sneak-left-click a second eligible block to set Corner B.
3. Left-click normally inside the completed selection to begin excavation.

Sneak-left-click a saved corner to clear the selection. With a completed selection, sneak-left-click another eligible block to start a new selection. Hammer right-click remains available for normal offhand interaction.

The server checks block eligibility, selection limits, tool durability, and drops. A local outline shows the selected area. Optional TotemAutomata integration lets Copper Golems use the hammers as tools, with one authorized gathering target at a time.

The mod also lets you right-click mature supported crops with a hoe to harvest and replant them. It reserves a planting item and uses hoe durability; normal loot and Fortune behavior apply.

## Installation

Install this mod, Fabric API, and [TotemLibrary (the TotemCore dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/totemlibrary) on both client and server. Current releases require Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Java 25 or newer, and TotemCore >=0.7.18 and <0.8.0. TotemAutomata is optional.
